sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the verified conditional enumeration: Category A is accepted as an exception, both supplied at-least-thin ice conditions require Category B, and the explicitly listed non-qualifying conditions impose no category result beyond the independently declared ship category. Target, owner paths, controlled values, cardinalities, and canonical namespace are correct.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic. The current third sh:or branch accepts any non-thin designIceCondition with no required category, and the second branch recognizes only exact thin ice, so it omits the “at least thin” medium-ice case and can let an invalid category B/C classification pass. Encode the implication as: category A; or a qualifying design condition at least thin (including the supplied thin and medium controlled values) with category B; or a demonstrably non-qualifying design condition where this requirement imposes no category result. Constrain the non-qualifying alternative explicitly to the applicable supplied controlled values, rather than using a broad negation, and retain the ship target and owner paths.

Remove sh:maxCount 0 from the non-qualifying designIceCondition alternative. For the explicitly listed less-severe, ice-free, open-water, and other-waters values, this requirement imposes no category result; it must not require shipCategory to be absent or thereby reject a separately declared category. Retain the ship target, owner paths, single designIceCondition input, Category A alternative, and Category B alternative for both supplied at-least-thin values.

The candidate faithfully encodes the verified conditional enumeration: Category A is accepted as an exception, both supplied at-least-thin ice conditions require Category B, and the explicitly listed non-qualifying conditions impose no category result beyond the independently declared ship category. Target, owner paths, controlled values, cardinalities, and canonical namespace are correct.
